summary: Bounded uncertainty-aware exploration: Primary/Explorer/Avoid classification, deterministic seeded draw, one explorer maximum, pin and hard-boundary safety
implementation: electron/learning/routing/exploration-policy.ts: planExploration — classifies candidates (PRIMARY / EXPLORER / AVOID); EXPLORER requires uncertainty (confidence < threshold) AND competitiveness (utility within margin of best); AVOID (confident + utility below floor) is never explored; at most ONE explorer per decision; deterministic FNV-seeded draw compared against epsilon (epsilon 0 disables); uncertainty bonus applied to the chosen explorer only; explicit pin keeps the top position; no authority over eligibility (only reorders candidates the hard layer produced)

electron/learning/routing/adaptive-scorer.ts (+): reads the exploration plan, applies adjusted utilities for ordering, and reports exploration {enabled, reason} on the routing decision; deterministic tie-break preserved; fail-open behaviour unchanged
tests: tests/unit/engine-phase-9.test.ts (7 tests): A32 uncertain-but-competitive candidate explored (bonus applied, reason recorded); A31 confident low performer classified AVOID and never explored; bounded + deterministic (exactly one explorer, identical plans across calls); epsilon 0 ⇒ pure exploitation; A26 pin retained even against a large exploration bonus; scorer reports exploration in the decision while keeping the candidate set identical (A38/A39 boundary); RoleRouter exclusion never restored by exploration; Phase 6 regression suite still 13/13
notes: Addresses A26 (re-verified), A31/A32 boundaries, and the Engine §16 rule that learning/exploration can never bypass permissions or the ExecutionGate — the policy only reorders already-approved candidates.
